$description: Semantic inventory checked by tooling/check-foundations.ts in every brand × appearance × density context: every role must exist with its type on its axis (the file layer that defines it), and every contrast pair must reach its WCAG minimum (4.5 text, 3 borders, icons and focus). Translucent surfaces are composited on color.surface.default before measuring. Pairs are explicit: a role is tested on the backdrops it is designed for. color.surface.muted is a de-emphasized backdrop and is tested with primary and secondary content only; color.status.*.border is decorative (the tinted surface identifies the status) and is not tested. `invariants` lists dimension roles that must equal the sum of other dimension roles in every context (a derived role maintained by hand in each brand or density). color.item.* pairs are measured on the surfaces that hold lists (default, overlay) and on the item's own surfaces; color.elevation.border is decorative (the shadow and the surface identify the element) and is not tested.

invariants.note: A focus ring drawn at focus.offset outside a control stays concentric with it.
A text-only control keeps the same inline padding as a field.
